subject: english
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Omnivores get energy and nutrients from plant and animal materials by digesting carbs, protein, fat and fibre and metabolising the nutrients and energy of the sources ingested.

B. The many diverse animals categorised as omnivores may be divided into sub-categories based on their dietary habits.

C. An omnivore is an animal that can feed and thrive on both, plant and animal substances.

D. They also have the capacity to integrate food sources like algae, fungus and bacteria into their diet.
solution:
The correct answer is '**CADB**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting off a story, starting of an incident or an event, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
• **Sentence C** should be used first because this sentence provides the definition of an omnivore and sets the context for the rest of the paragraph.
 
• After Sentence C, **Sentence A **should be used because this sentence provides more information about omnivores.
 
• **Sentence D** should be used next because this sentence adds to the idea of omnivores being able to thrive on diverse food sources.
 
• Lastly, **Sentence B** will be used because this sentence provides further information on the sub-categories of omnivores based on their dietary habits.
 
• The order of the sentences in **Option 3** creates a logical flow of ideas that builds on the definition of omnivores and their ability to obtain energy and nutrients from diverse sources. It then goes on to provide more specific information on the sub-categories of omnivores.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sequence:__** *An omnivore is an animal that can feed and thrive on both, plant and animal substances. Omnivores get energy and nutrients from plant and animal materials by digesting carbs, protein, fat and fibre and metabolising the nutrients and energy of the sources ingested. They also have the capacity to integrate food sources like algae, fungus and bacteria into their diet. The many diverse animals categorised as omnivores may be divided into sub-categories based on their dietary habits.*
